description: END29, synthetic, code-derived (not seen in the field): Teams releases its input for a headphone switch at 900 s and the mic's return never reaches the engine (DET8's re-registration under an object the resolver does not follow). The Leave button and the call window read live throughout, so the mic-led hold neither pairs nor lone-confirms; before END29 the lone dwell ended it at 1620 s, cut back to the switch.
